decision: Selected the planar centroid of Dakota County tax parcel 20-74900-01-010 (Lot 1, Block 1, Taylor Addition; 5842 Carmen Ave, Inver Grove Heights), the parcel named in Resolution 2026-209, as the campus locator for the whole Project Bedrock data-centre site.

facts.pin_bridge: Resolution 2026-209 (draft in the 28 September 2026 packet) names PID 20-74900-01-010 and legal description Lot 1, Block 1, Taylor Addition; the county layer stores the same PIN with its county prefix as 037-207490001010
facts.address_bridge: the county parcel and the Project Bedrock site-plan title sheet give 5842 Carmen Ave (E.); the resolution, request for council action and site improvement agreement call the same 13.9-acre parcel 5890 Carmen Avenue
facts.coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude as returned with outSR=4326 from the county layer stored in NAD83 / UTM zone 15N (EPSG:26915); the UTM-projected centroid was computed for comparison
